title.zh: 写实的毛发：生成结果 vs 文献的数量和尺寸
title.en: Lifelike hair: what the generator built vs published counts and sizes

method.zh: 生成结果取自每个人体的 public/anatomy/<body>/hair/hair.json（tools/hair/build.ts 在生成时数出的根数、密度、长度分位数）；参照取自 data/curated/hair/hair.json 列出的文献（那里标明了 cited / secondary / assumed）。本表只读，不重新生成毛发。
method.en: What was built comes from each body's public/anatomy/<body>/hair/hair.json (counts, densities and length percentiles tallied by tools/hair/build.ts while generating); the references are the literature listed in data/curated/hair/hair.json (where every value is marked cited / secondary / assumed). This table only reads; it regenerates no hair.

tolerance.zh: 文献给范围时落在范围内记 within；给均值和标准差时差在 1 SD 内；胡须密度按比值 ×/÷ 1.25。参照本身是假设的项记 not comparable。
tolerance.en: Inside the range where the literature gives one; within 1 SD where it gives mean and SD; beard densities by a ratio within ×/÷ 1.25. Items whose reference is itself an assumption are not comparable.

references.name: Leerunyakul K, Suchonwanit P 2020, Asian Hair: A Review of Structures, Properties, and Distinctive Disorders. Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol 13:309–318
references.version: PMC7187942; Table 1 (pooled densities; review, values quoted from other studies)
references.clause: Licence field of the Europe PMC record ("cc by-nc"). Only the pooled density mean and SD are cited.

references.name: Flindt R 2006, Amazing Numbers in Biology, Springer, p. 212, via BioNumbers 101509
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. Only the range is cited as a fact.

references.name: Evaluation of Hair Density and Hair Diameter in the Adult Thai Population Using Quantitative Trichoscopic Analysis. BioMed Res Int 2020
references.version: PMC7035527; temporoparietal versus other scalp regions (value seen as a quoted snippet)
references.clause: Licence field of the Europe PMC record ("cc by"). Only the ratio of regional densities is cited.

references.name: Patel BC, Lopez MJ, Joos ZP. Anatomy, Head and Neck: Eyelash. StatPearls (NBK537278)
references.version: quoted through Wikipedia "Eyelash": 90–160 upper, 75–80 lower lashes
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. Only the two count ranges are cited as facts.

references.name: Wikipedia, "Eyelash"
references.version: accessed 2026-10; lash lengths 7–8 mm upper, 5–6 mm lower (citing Thibaut et al. 2009, Na et al. 2006)
references.clause: Wikipedia text is published under CC BY-SA 4.0; only two length ranges are cited as facts.

references.name: Dua K, Verma V, Dua A 2021, Beard and Moustache Reconstruction. Indian J Plast Surg 54(4):483–488
references.version: PMC8719972; follicular-unit densities by beard region (authors' observation)
references.clause: Licence field of the Europe PMC record ("cc by-nc-nd"). Only the regional densities are quoted as facts.

notes.zh: 生成器按目标密度撒毛囊；表里的密度是生成后在皮肤面积上数出来的，与目标的差来自边界、梯度和随机性。
notes.en: The generator scatters follicles at a target density; the densities here are counted over the skin area after generation, and differences from the target come from borders, gradients and randomness.

note.zh: 白种人汇总均值 ± 1 SD（综述，转引）
参照是泰国成人的颞顶区 / 其余区；容差 0.1 是本表所定
note.en: the reference is temporoparietal / elsewhere in Thai adults; the 0.1 tolerance is set by this table

note.zh: 参照 200–400（250）只有无出处的科普数字，记为假设
note.en: the 200–400 (250) reference is only an unsourced popular figure, recorded as an assumption
the 5–11 mm reference is an assumption

note.zh: 文献是毛囊单位密度，胡须多为单根单位；容差 ×/÷ 1.25 是本表所定
note.en: the source gives follicular-unit densities, and beard units are mostly single hairs; the ×/÷ 1.25 tolerance is set by this table
